purpose: Design for the indexing build: fixing targets, confirming and assigning DLIDs, detecting change sets, generating needed info, committing the ToC candidate, and returning a count-only result with a detail file.
summary: I/O and execution boundary of the build, which never rewrites Index target documents
Target fixing: argument combination rules, directory/pattern expansion, exclusion, path normalization, symlinks, Markdown detection
ID confirmation: documents without a doc_link_id or with duplicates are excluded and reported while the build continues
DLID assignment operation: explicit start, duplicate original resolution, random 60-bit Crockford Base32 issuance, section IDs on headings
Change set determination: new, left target, path change, content hash change, reference change, and section-level add/delete/move/heading/body changes
Move detection via a per-key record file under .temp/doc-link/index-docs, aggregated by script and deleted after publishing
Information acquisition: reuse of AI-generated info, AI generation only for new or changed documents, candidate validation, atomic bulk publish
Completion result: stdout holds items and counts only, per-type counts, reference check results, and the detail file path
Detail file holding full change set and generated documents, written atomically before publishing the ToC
Write units using os.replace, no locking, and rerun behavior after failure
tasks: Implementing or modifying index-docs build script
Designing or testing target specification expansion and exclusion
Implementing change set and move detection
Implementing the completion result and detail file output
Reviewing ToC build and publish atomicity
Diagnosing build failures and rerun behavior
title: DES-005 対象確定・DLID 付与・[ToC]構築設計
